findings.statement: The fail-closed marker `VERIFYING->IMPLEMENTING` on the record at M assumes the only way to spread one Change's code over several merged PRs is a repeat after a merged `VERIFYING`. The lifecycle allows other ways, so the marker is too narrow. PR1 carries class code (`packages/cli/src/**`), no `human-acceptance` in `classification`, and a record in `IMPLEMENTING`. Its CI is red (`CHANGE_NOT_VERIFYING`, `RECORD_MISMATCH` `classification`), but the forge is not configured and the bot merges it: the same precondition as round-3 F-2. PR2 carries only `IMPLEMENTING->VERIFYING`. Its CI is green: the base record has no profile and the diff classifies to nothing. The bot merges PR2 at M. The record at M has no `VERIFYING->IMPLEMENTING`, M^1 policy has no `human-approval`, and the exception applies. The class code lands without a human, which contradicts the design Goals ("impl-PR класса, слитый ботом, судья ловит в archive-PR"). The same happens when `APPROVED` or `APPROVED->IMPLEMENTING` is merged in a separate PR. The marker is also too wide: a `VERIFYING->IMPLEMENTING->VERIFYING` backtrack inside one impl-PR branch (allowed by 04 §2) closes the exception for an honest single impl-PR.
findings.recommendation: Replace the marker with a condition on the base of the impl-PR. The exception holds only if the record of the Change at M^1 is absent or in `SPECIFIED` or earlier, i.e. the whole chain `APPROVED`…`VERIFYING` is introduced by M. Otherwise fail-closed with `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED`. This covers the repeat (record at M^1 is `VERIFYING`), the `IMPLEMENTING` split and the separate `APPROVED`, and it does not punish an in-branch backtrack. Add a scenario: bot-merged PR1 in `IMPLEMENTING` with class code, then bot-merged PR2 `IMPLEMENTING->VERIFYING` with the record only, gives `REF_NOT_VERIFIED` `merged_by` and `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED`.

findings.statement: The scope of the `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED` finding is not fixed. The REQ lists three fail-closed conditions: "policy по M^1 содержит `human-approval`", "не вычисляется", and "содержит переход `VERIFYING->IMPLEMENTING`". But it ties the finding only to "При fail-closed без вычисленной policy". SCN-VER-135 (policy computed) expects the finding. Design D3 names fail-closed only for non-computable policy and the repeat, not for a policy with `human-approval`. Two cases are open. SCN-VER-131 (policy with `human-approval`, agent merged): is there an `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED`? Every honest class impl-PR merged by the maintainer, including the `agent-merge` impl-PR itself: is there a finding when the ref is verified? Readings differ in `data.findings[]`, and tests of SCN-VER-131, SCN-VER-135 (second part) and SCN-VER-091 cannot assert presence or absence.
findings.recommendation: Call a policy with `human-approval` a normal human-acceptance case, not fail-closed. State that `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED` is emitted exactly when the exception is closed by a non-computable M^1 policy or by the record condition, and say whether it depends on the ref being verified. Add to SCN-VER-131 "находки `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED` нет". Add to the second part of SCN-VER-135 whether the finding is present.

findings.statement: The INV-03 / agent carve-out depends on the gate, not on whether the exception applies. Line 104 says: "merged_by, равный автору PR (INV-03) или входящий в identities.agents … SHALL быть REF_NOT_VERIFIED …, кроме ref MERGED без gate human-approval (выше)". In the repeat case (SCN-VER-135), M^1 policy has no `human-approval`, so the literal carve-out applies: the author may merge their own PR. Fail-closed says "Исключения нет", and design D3 says the role must be "не агент, не автор". The case of a `roles.maintainer` member who authored and merged the repeat impl-PR (non-empty `identities.agents`) gets a verified ref under one reading and `REF_NOT_VERIFIED` `merged_by` under the other. The same conflict holds when policy is not computable: whether a gate exists is then unknown.
findings.recommendation: Rephrase the carve-out as "кроме ref `MERGED`, к которому применяется исключение для агента (не fail-closed)". Add to SCN-VER-135: the repeat impl-PR opened and merged by the same `roles.maintainer` member, with non-empty `identities.agents`, gives `REF_NOT_VERIFIED` `merged_by`.

proposals.change: Ref `MERGED`: replace "или если record Change на M содержит переход `VERIFYING->IMPLEMENTING`" with "или если record Change на M^1 есть и его `change_state` дальше `SPECIFIED` (цепочку `APPROVED`…`VERIFYING` внёс не только M)". Add a scenario for the `IMPLEMENTING` split.

Separate a policy with `human-approval` (the normal rule) from fail-closed (non-computable policy, record condition). `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED` goes only to fail-closed. The line-104 carve-out becomes "кроме ref `MERGED`, к которому применяется исключение для агента". Clarify SCN-VER-131 and SCN-VER-135.

assumptions.statement: An impl-kind PR in `APPROVED` or `IMPLEMENTING` state is red in CI (`CHANGE_NOT_VERIFYING`), so the F-1 bypass, like round-3 F-2, needs a bot to merge a red PR with an unconfigured forge. The session closed round-3 F-2 under the same precondition, so F-1 is not the accepted residual risk of kind none.
In SRA records only `identities` has two transitions to `IMPLEMENTING` (the repeat). An in-branch backtrack `VERIFYING->IMPLEMENTING` has not happened in practice, but 04 §2 allows it.
